maria-cs: Milestone0 sync for PorterBridge private deployment — quick pass: TGW routes, NAT egress, KMS cross-account, CloudTrail delivery, S3 retention. Any red flags?
oliver-se: TGW attachment done; missing route 10.12.9.0/24 -> tgw-0f1. I can push that now.
jess-eng: Pushed route at 10:07Z; propagation shows "available". Ran curl -> collector 3.98.77.21:443; collector returned 403 (IP not whitelisted).
raj-infra: Created CMK alias/porterbridge-audit. Default key policy limits to account root only. Customer requires cross-account decrypt for ops role arn:aws:iam::222333444:role/porter-ops.
maria-cs: Can we add the ops principal and validate before EOD? Renewal review scheduled next Tue — flag if approval slips.
jess-eng: Policy snippet I recommend: {"Sid":"AllowOps","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::222333444:role/porter-ops"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"} — will paste into runbook once approved.
ops-bot: cloudtrail_event: Trail "porter-org-trail" created at 2026-07-01T10:05Z
raj-infra: Bucket policy initially had a Deny for non-org principals; I added an explicit Allow for cloudtrail.amazonaws.com and set lifecycle to 7 years per customer. Re-delivery of PutObject succeeded.
oliver-se: Collector whitelist needed: 3.98.77.21 and 34.99.11.5. PM notified and asked to confirm within 2 hours.
maria-cs: Risk: KMS approval delay — if not approved by Friday, escalate renewal risk to AM/Sales. @oliver-se add to risk tracker with mitigation (temporary ingest key we manage, audit-only).
oliver-se: Added risk "KMS cross-account approval pending" with mitigation and owner.
jess-eng: After policy tweak I ran a decrypt smoke: succeeded from ops role test credentials. Will upload commands to runbook.
maria-cs: Actions recap: raj - update runbook with final KMS & bucket snippets; oliver - follow up on whitelist + risk tracker; jess - paste decrypt test and commands; maria - run renewal probe Thu 09:00 UTC. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
